# ACGI catalogue and software workspace

Version 0.1 · Rasniki expandable collection

ACGI is retained as the author's label; no expansion or technical standard has been supplied. “Max” means a goal of broad coverage, not a claim that every named application is complete. Unfamiliar category names remain provisional and are not silently treated as established sciences or legal terms.

## Implemented

Open catalogue.html for a searchable, paginated catalogue, category selection, local selection trends, and a common draft workspace. The catalogue distinguishes implemented components from prototype and proposed components.

The workspace generates specification-to-product briefs, practical planning outlines, and review records for every category. These are templates, not fully implemented domain applications. It exports Markdown and supports a local image, audio, or video preview. Selected media is neither uploaded nor saved. Choose only material you have permission to use; previews do not establish rights or endorsement.

The page has an exact integer addition/multiplication calculator and an eight-bit bitflip tool. These are implemented utilities, not exact-science certification or a kerot instruction extension. The K0 assembler and interpreter remain separate Python-hosted software.

## Catalogue and trends

Pagination uses six entries per page. Search matches category names, purpose, status, and review notes. Trend order measures category selections in the current page session only; it represents neither market trends nor public popularity. Reset trends removes those local counts. Page refresh also clears them.

## Spec to product

Every brief records the chosen category, intended purpose, audience, acceptance check, owners, dependencies, limitations, and review requirements. Franchise and merchandise briefs require explicit rights and license review; a draft cannot grant permission to use another party's marks or works. Nonwuvnonliv remains an author-supplied merchandise label without an established definition.

## Professional and critical domains

Emergency and urgency categories organize preparedness records, not dispatch, emergency response, diagnosis, or real-time alerts. In an actual emergency use the appropriate local emergency service.

Attorney, solicitor, contractual, political, and jurisdiction categories produce unreviewed planning records. They do not supply legal representation, executable legally valid agreements, election authority, or automatic compliance. Locations entered into a template do not determine which laws actually apply. Current authoritative sources and appropriate review remain necessary before reliance.

Charity plans do not process donations or verify charitable status. Safety categories do not certify equipment or procedures. Companion tools do not provide a human relationship or professional care. Robotics and automation categories do not control devices. Larynx categories do not diagnose or treat voice conditions.

“Vs nonmysoftwares” and “vs nonally” are interpreted as authorized compatibility and comparison work. They confer no access rights and contain no attack or interference tools. “Taming” is interpreted as humane, consent-based learning or behavior support. Sake, asake, sakety, asakety, tram, and amakkakah retain their supplied spellings and provisional scopes.

## Collection boundaries

This catalogue covers the requested families, but most specialized domain systems remain proposed. The common draft generator is operational; a category's presence does not mean its specialist software is implemented. No cloud accounts, money movement, credential store, user accounts, database, or external APIs are configured.

All browser processing is local. Generated text is inserted as text rather than evaluated as code. The page uses no external libraries. No AI model or automated professional judgment runs inside the workspace. The source itself is AI-assisted.

## Verification

Run `node software/test_catalogue.cjs` from the repository root. Node.js is a test host; the catalogue itself runs in a browser without installation.

Relevant checks exercise query filtering, pagination, local trend ordering, generated draft fields, exact integer arithmetic, bitflip bounds, and invalid input. Media previews use native browser controls; playback support depends on the browser and file format and is not certified by these checks.
